discomName: TP Central Odisha Distribution Ltd (TPCODL, OERC)

connectionTypes.sourceNote: PRIMARY — OERC Retail Supply Tariff Notification for FY 2026-27 dated 24.03.2026 (Case Nos. 136-139/2025 for TPCODL; one common schedule for all four Odisha DISCOMs), effective 01.04.2026, Category 1.b 'Domestic — Others': 290 paise/kWh for consumption <=50 units/month, 470 for >50 and <=200, 570 for >200 and <=400, 610 above 400. Monthly Minimum Fixed Charge Rs 20 for the first kW or part thereof and Rs 20 for each additional kW or part thereof, modelled here as Rs 20/kW. Not modelled: Kutir Jyoti (<=30 units/month, fixed Rs 70/month), the 10 paise/unit rebate shown against the category, meter rent, and electricity duty (levied by the State over and above the tariff). Source: https://www.orierc.org/CuteSoft_Client/writereaddata/upload/DISCOMs_Tariff_Notification_FY_2026-27.PDF

PRIMARY — OERC state-wide DISCOM Retail Supply Tariff Notification for FY2025-26 (applies uniformly to all four Odisha DISCOMs including TPCODL), Category 2 'General Purpose < 110 kVA': 0-100 units @ Rs 5.90/unit, 101-300 @ Rs 7.00/unit, >300 @ Rs 7.60/unit; fixed charge Rs 30/kW/month (uniform for first and additional kW). Extracted from TPSODL's published copy of the identical statewide notification: https://www.tpsouthernodisha.com/Editor_UploadedDocuments/Content/TPSODL_Tariff_Notification_2025-26.pdf (cross-referenced against OERC's own notification page at orierc.org and secondary aggregator thediscombill.com, which independently reported the same Rs 30/kW fixed charge for this category).

PRIMARY — OERC state-wide DISCOM Retail Supply Tariff Notification for FY2025-26 (applies uniformly to all Odisha DISCOMs), Category 7 'L.T. Industrial (S) Supply <22 kVA': flat Rs 6.20/unit (not slabbed); fixed charge Rs 80/kW/month for the first kW, Rs 35/kW/month for each additional kW (this entry uses the first-kW rate as representative). Category 8 'L.T. Industrial (M) Supply >=22kVA <110kVA' (same energy rate, fixed Rs 100/first kW + Rs 80/additional kW) not modelled. Source: https://www.tpsouthernodisha.com/Editor_UploadedDocuments/Content/TPSODL_Tariff_Notification_2025-26.pdf (identical statewide schedule also applicable to TPCODL).

PRIMARY — OERC state-wide DISCOM Retail Supply Tariff Notification for FY2025-26 (applies uniformly to all Odisha DISCOMs), Category 3 'Irrigation Pumping and Agriculture' (LT): flat Rs 1.50/unit (not slabbed); fixed charge Rs 20/kW/month for the first kW, Rs 10/kW/month for each additional kW (this entry uses the first-kW rate as representative). Category 4 'Allied Agricultural Activities' (Rs 1.60/unit, fixed Rs 20/Rs 10) not modelled. Source: https://www.tpsouthernodisha.com/Editor_UploadedDocuments/Content/TPSODL_Tariff_Notification_2025-26.pdf (identical statewide schedule also applicable to TPCODL).
